description: A FUNCTION-ID paragraph opening a user-defined function definition (ISO §2023:11.5 Format 1 / §2023:10.6.1 function-definition) and its END FUNCTION marker (§2023:10.7.2) - COBOL-2002 introductions: X3.23-1985 has neither the paragraph nor the end-marker alternative (kb/Work PB988, row FMT-10.7.2). Below 2002 VersionConformancePass ParseArm.VisitFunctionIdParagraph names the edition (0900) on recognition. The prototype format (IS PROTOTYPE) is its own row, function-prototype-2002, fired on the prototypePhrase node, so a prototype is gated once. END FUNCTION closing a PROGRAM-ID unit is §2023:10.6.1's keyword rule (COBOL2274) at every edition, so no END FUNCTION reaches an accepted COBOL-85 source.
vcr: 2002 introduction (derive from the 2002 standard - Annex E covers 2014-2023 only); user-defined functions arrive with the FUNCTION-ID paragraph
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
FUNCTION-ID. FDDBL.
DATA DIVISION.
LINKAGE SECTION.
01 L-X PIC 9(4).
01 L-R PIC 9(4).
PROCEDURE DIVISION USING L-X RETURNING L-R.
P.
    COMPUTE L-R = L-X * 2.
    GOBACK.
END FUNCTION FDDBL.
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMFD1.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
REPOSITORY.
    FUNCTION FDDBL.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W PIC 9(4).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    COMPUTE W = FUNCTION FDDBL(21).
    STOP RUN.
END PROGRAM VMFD1.
